title: Pause a voice AI agent mid-call and bring it back
summary: Put the caller on hold with a spoken line, take them off it, or end the AI on a call that keeps running, each with one REST command.
scenario: Your backend needs a moment to finish a lookup, and the agent should stop listening until it is done

folds: round 7 gap: live-call control over REST
evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json Calling.CallRequest variant calling.ai_hold: params timeout (type string; description says it must be sent as a string and that integer payloads are rejected) and prompt (a system message the AI speaks before hold music)
tools/openapi/rest.json calling.ai_unhold: no params; calling.ai.stop: one param, control_id, described as a reserved field that is currently ignored
sdk rest/namespaces/calling.py:125-132 ai_hold, ai_unhold, and ai_stop, whose command string is calling.ai.stop
npm @signalwire/sdk 2.0.5 dist/rest/namespaces/calling.js aiStop sends the same calling.ai.stop
